meaning: Labels on public-boundary posts, not proof of a category/tag/author URL or equivalence to Topic/Person/Series. Existing slug adapters must resolve labels.
query: with p as (select id,categories,tags,author from public.posts where not exists(select 1 from unnest(tags) tag where trim(tag) in ('טיוטה','פורום'))) select 'category' as kind,value,count(*) as posts from p cross join lateral unnest(categories) value group by value union all select 'tag',value,count(*) from p cross join lateral unnest(tags) value group by value union all select 'author',author,count(*) from p group by author order by kind,posts desc;
